claude-code-in-action.title: Claude Code in Action · Claude Academy
claude-code-in-action.description: Run long, hands-off Claude Code sessions you can trust: steer, configure, automate, and verify

introduction-to-claude-cowork.title: Introduction to Claude Cowork · Claude Academy

ai-capabilities-and-limitations.title: AI Capabilities and Limitations · Claude Academy

ai-fluency-for-builders.title: AI Fluency for Builders · Claude Academy

ai-fluency-for-small-businesses.title: AI Fluency for Small Businesses · Claude Academy

Applies the framework to everyday business tasks like research, customer data, and operations while staying true to your mission and values.

ai-fluency-for-students.title: AI Fluency for students · Claude Academy

ai-fluency-framework-foundations.title: AI Fluency: Framework & Foundations · Claude Academy
ai-fluency-framework-foundations.description: Learn to collaborate with AI effectively, efficiently, ethically, and safely using the 4D framework: Delegation, Description, Discernment, and Diligence.
